guide.resident.0.body: Walk through with your phone. FixList maps the floor and takes guided photos.
guide.resident.1.title: Review flagged spots
guide.resident.1.body: AI suggestions point out spots worth a closer look, like a rug edge or a loose cord. They may be wrong. You decide what’s a problem.
guide.resident.2.title: Fix it, or ask for help
guide.resident.2.body: Easy fixes come first. Share a task with family or a volunteer when you want a hand.
guide.resident.3.title: Ask for help on your terms
guide.resident.3.body: Choose what to share, invite a volunteer, agree on a time and review their completion report. Nothing is sent outside this device.
guide.helper: You can help {name} with the parts they share with you.
guide.volunteer.0.title: See what’s shared with you
guide.volunteer.0.body: See only the tasks and details a resident chooses to share.
guide.volunteer.1.title: Agree on a time
guide.volunteer.1.body: Accept a task, suggest a time, and wait for the resident to agree.
guide.volunteer.2.title: Report when it’s done
guide.volunteer.2.body: Add an update when you finish. The resident checks the work and records the result.
guide.volunteer.3.title: Keep the resident informed
guide.volunteer.3.body: Propose a time, share short updates and report when you are done. The resident reviews completion; independent verification is unavailable.

catalog.check.rug-check: Does a rug edge obstruct the walking route?
catalog.action.review-rug.title: Review the rug placement
catalog.action.review-rug.nextStep: Take up the rug, or hold it down with double-sided rug tape or a non-slip pad.
catalog.check.cord-check: Does a cord cross the walking route?
catalog.action.review-cord.title: Review the cord route
catalog.action.review-cord.nextStep: Move the cord along the wall and tape or clip it down so it does not cross the path. If you need another outlet, ask an electrician.
catalog.check.stair-clutter-check: Are there objects in the way on the stairs?
catalog.action.review-stair-clutter.next: Clear everything off the stairs and keep the steps empty.
catalog.action.review-handrail.title: Seek review of the stair handrail
catalog.action.review-handrail.nextStep: Have a qualified professional fix the loose handrail. Handrails on both sides of the stairs help most.
catalog.check.stair-lighting-check: Are the stairs missing a light or an easy-to-reach switch?
catalog.action.review-stair-lighting.nex: Ask an electrician to add a light with switches at the top and bottom of the stairs.
catalog.check.night-lighting-check: Is the path from bed to bathroom dark?
catalog.action.review-night-lighting.nex: Put a lamp within reach of the bed and plug in night-lights along the path to the bathroom.
catalog.action.review-shower-surface.nex: Put a non-slip rubber mat or self-stick strips on the tub or shower floor.
catalog.check.bathroom-support-check: Is a needed grab bar missing by the tub or toilet?
catalog.action.review-bathroom-support.n: Have a qualified installer put grab bars next to and inside the tub and next to the toilet.
catalog.photo.rug-check.question: Is a rug or mat edge visibly raised, curled, or bunched on a walking path in this photo, where someone could trip?
catalog.photo.rug-check.limitation: A photo does not establish whether a rug is secured or whether the route is used.
catalog.photo.cord-check.question: Is a visible loose cord or cable crossing an open floor area used as a walking path in this photo?
catalog.photo.cord-check.limitation: The visible path and cable may be partly occluded; actual use is unknown.
catalog.photo.stair-clutter-check.questi: Are loose objects visibly occupying a stair tread or the walking area of a stair landing in this photo?
catalog.photo.stair-clutter-check.limita: This covers visible steps only, not the entire staircase.
catalog.photo.handrail-check.question: Does a visible stair handrail have an obvious break, detached bracket, or visibly separated wall or floor attachment in this photo?
catalog.photo.handrail-check.limitation: Visible damage is a proxy. A single photo cannot test looseness or load capacity.
catalog.photo.stair-lighting-check.quest: Are visible stair treads or a stair landing so dimly lit in this photo that their edges are difficult to distinguish?
catalog.photo.stair-lighting-check.limit: Exposure affects apparent brightness. A photo cannot establish missing lighting, switch accessibility, or normal lighting conditions.
catalog.photo.night-lighting-check.quest: Is a visible walking path beside a bed or through a bedroom doorway so dimly lit in this photo that floor obstacles would be difficult to see?
catalog.photo.night-lighting-check.limit: A single photo cannot establish a bed-to-bathroom route or its nighttime lighting.
catalog.photo.shower-surface-check.quest: Is pooled water, a visibly wet glossy patch, or a loose bunched mat visible on a bathtub or shower floor in this photo?
catalog.photo.shower-surface-check.limit: Visible wetness or a loose mat is a proxy. A photo cannot measure friction or determine slipperiness.
catalog.photo.bathroom-support-check.que: Is a bathtub, shower, or toilet and its adjoining wall visible in this photo with no grab bar visible beside that fixture?
catalog.photo.bathroom-support-check.lim: An out-of-frame bar may exist. A photo cannot determine a person's support needs or whether a bar is properly installed.

c.intro.promise: A little help at home. A neighbor who cares.

c.intro.step1body: Talk, type, or show us a spot in your room.
c.intro.step2body: Check the tools, time, and details. You decide what to post.
c.intro.step3body: Choose a time together. You confirm when the help is done.
